delay.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for UPnP IGD device responses during discovery.

multicast_if.description: Network interface to use for sending SSDP discover packets. Leave empty to use the default.

minissdpd_sock.description: Path to the MiniSSDPd socket to use pre-gathered device data. Leave empty to use default path.

local_port.description: Source port for SSDP packets. 0 for system-assigned, 1900 (UPNP_LOCAL_PORT_SAME) for same as dest, or specific port number.

ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 for the UPnP discovery process.

rootdescurl.description: Direct URL to the UPnP IGD root description XML, bypassing the discovery process.

lan_addr.description: LAN address for the UPnP interface. Leave empty for auto-detection.

wan_addr.description: WAN address for the UPnP interface. Leave empty for auto-detection.
